description: Defer agent session transcript persistence behind an in-grain TranscriptAccumulator and a one-shot Orleans timer, with structured logging and synchronous deactivation flush.

tasks.title: Refactor TranscriptAccumulator to two-phase flush
tasks.spec: specs/agent-session-persistence/spec.md#TranscriptAccumulator accepts events with void return / TranscriptAccumulator exposes two-phase flush interface / session.input prompt info is captured for the next flush
tasks.description: Change TranscriptAccumulator.Accept to void, remove forceFlushPending, accumulate text deltas in _pending and part deltas in _accumulatedParts, capture session.input prompt text/kind/timestamp, and expose BuildFlush (peek) and CommitFlush (clear).
acceptanceCriteria: Accept returns void and accumulates text and part deltas internally
BuildFlush returns combined flush without clearing _accumulatedParts or input tracking
CommitFlush clears _pending, _accumulatedParts, and input tracking
session.input values are included in the next BuildFlush turn

tasks.title: Make transcript store idempotent and label sync defensive
tasks.spec: specs/agent-session-persistence/spec.md#SavePartsAsync upserts by type and correlation key / SyncLabelsAsync logs warning on null labels
tasks.description: Ensure IAgentSessionTranscriptStore.SavePartsAsync upserts rows by type + correlationKey so retries do not duplicate parts, and add a LogWarning in IAgentSessionStore.SyncLabelsAsync when labels are null.
acceptanceCriteria: Retrying the same flush updates existing type+correlationKey rows instead of inserting duplicates
New correlation keys still insert new rows
SyncLabelsAsync logs a warning with session ID when labels are null and completes without throwing
tasks.output: Store implementations updated; store unit tests pass

tasks.title: Defer persistence in AgentSessionGrain
tasks.spec: specs/agent-session-persistence/spec.md#AppendRuntimeEventsAsync returns without database writes / AgentSessionGrain uses one-shot Orleans timer for deferred persistence; specs/coder-session-tracking/spec.md#AppendRuntimeEventsAsync defers persistence
tasks.description: Remove inline _stateStore.SaveAsync and _transcriptStore.SaveAsync calls from AppendRuntimeEventsAsync, set _stateDirty when domain state changes, and register a one-shot Orleans timer (200ms due, no period) when state or transcript data becomes dirty.
acceptanceCriteria: AppendRuntimeEventsAsync returns before any DB write
RecordActivity / ApplyUsage / ResolveModel set _stateDirty = true
A one-shot 200ms timer is registered only when dirty and not already active
FanOutRealtimeAsync remains inline

tasks.title: Implement PersistCallback with retry and structured logging
tasks.spec: specs/agent-session-persistence/spec.md#PersistCallback retries on failure / Persistence failures are logged with session context
tasks.description: Implement the timer callback that conditionally saves dirty state, peeks and saves transcript flush, commits the accumulator only when both saves succeed, and logs structured errors with session ID, part counts, and exception details.
acceptanceCriteria: State save and transcript save each have try-catch LogError with session ID and exception details
Transcript log includes part count
CommitFlush and timer disposal happen only after both saves succeed
On failure the timer remains active for retry
tasks.output: PersistCallback implemented in AgentSessionGrain; grain unit tests cover success and failure paths

tasks.title: Add synchronous deactivation flush
tasks.spec: specs/agent-session-persistence/spec.md#OnDeactivateAsync flushes remaining state and transcript synchronously
tasks.description: Update OnDeactivateAsync to dispose the persistence timer and synchronously flush remaining dirty state and transcript, logging any failure and returning cleanly.
acceptanceCriteria: Timer is disposed before flushing
Remaining dirty state and transcript are persisted inline
Exceptions are logged with session ID and do not propagate
tasks.output: OnDeactivateAsync updated in AgentSessionGrain; deactivation tests pass

tasks.title: Update tests for deferred persistence semantics
tasks.description: Update grain and accumulator tests to assert deferred persistence behavior: no immediate rows after AppendRuntimeEventsAsync, data appears after timer flush, retries preserve completeness via upsert, and committed transcript remains visible.
acceptanceCriteria: AppendRuntimeEventsAsync tests no longer assert immediate state/transcript store calls
Tests advance/flush the timer and verify persisted rows
Retry scenario confirms no duplicate parts
All server unit tests pass
tasks.output: Updated test suite; dotnet test passes

tasks.title: Validate session detail transcript completeness
tasks.description: Run an end-to-end or integration check that the session detail page shows a complete transcript after deferred persistence commits, including text deltas and tool parts.
acceptanceCriteria: Session processed after the change displays all transcript parts
No committed parts are missing
No duplicate parts are visible
tasks.output: Validation notes or integration test result confirming complete transcript
